defs.meaning: 使高兴；觉得高兴；外出玩乐（pleasure 的第三人称单数）

examples.en: Why should you deprive yourself of such simple pleasures?
examples.zh: 你为什么连这种简单的娱乐也不让自己享受一下呢？

examples.en: It was she who first introduced the pleasures of sailing to me.
examples.zh: 是她最先使我体会到了帆船运动的乐趣。

examples.en: One of the greatest pleasures of this job is meeting people from all walks of life.
examples.zh: 这份工作最大的乐趣之一就是结识来自各行各业的人。
